mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates coordinated monetary easing and labor market improvement, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns on FEDFUNDS*UNRATE interaction term, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, a rising quarterly GDP growth rate signals strengthening economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the prior two months indicates robust consumer demand for housing, correlating with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and decline in industrial production indicates a shift from manufacturing to housing-driven economic activity, signaling recovery in consumer sectors and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns on HOUST*INDPRO interaction term, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an elevated federal funds rate above 4.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
